text: 灼热的子弹贯穿风行者的心脏。它弓起身子，踉跄着逃开，沿途撞开树木。你想起当地传说：风行者冰冷的心脏若被融化，它就会死去。你这幸运的一枪想必让它害怕失去这不自然的生命。
诺曼和西尔维娅走近，睡眼惺忪。你立刻命令他们收拾营地，尽快撤离此地。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 185
text: The hot bullet pierces the wind-walker’s heart. It doubles over and staggers away, brushing trees from its path. You remember from the area’s myths that the wind-walker will die if its icy heart is melted. Your lucky shot must have placed the creature in fear of its unnatural life.
Norman and Sylvia approach, blinking back sleep. You snap an order to strike the camp. You must evacuate the area as quickly as possible.
